qualification.details: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only.

how_to_apply: Prepare your application with a detailed CV including a chronological discipline of the degrees and certificates obtained.
Gather copies of your degree, certificate, mark sheets, and relevant experience certificates (research and industrial field).
Combine all documents into a single PDF file in the specified order.
Send the single PDF file through email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the office of the Principal Investigator by 15 October 2026, 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted as a single PDF file through email only; failing to do so will result in rejection during the shortlisting procedure. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview through email. Ensure eligibility before appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment position advertised by IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee advertised for 1 Research Associate position under the Civil Engineering Department for the project titled "Ultra-High-Performance Concrete for Building Applications Development and design parameters".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application to the Principal Investigator by email is 15 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of Rs. 58,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in Civil Engineering from a reputed institute such as IITs or IISc, along with experimental research experience in cementitious or advanced concrete materials.

faq.question: Q5. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted as a single PDF file containing a detailed CV, mark sheets, degree copies, and experience certificates sent via email to the Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Will TA/DA be provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the project position?
faq.answer: The position is available from the date of appointment until 18 November 2027.
